country: Al Jumhuriyah al Islamiyah al Muritaniyah

fields.terrain: mostly barren, flat plains of the Sahara; some central hills
fields.hazards: hot, dry, dust/sand-laden sirocco wind primarily in March and April; periodic droughts
fields.resources: iron ore, gypsum, copper, phosphate, diamonds, gold, oil, fish
fields.farm: rice, milk, goat milk, sorghum, sheep milk, lamb/mutton, beef, camel meat, camel milk, dates
fields.exports: gold, iron ore, fish, processed crustaceans, copper ore
fields.industries: fish processing, oil production, mining (iron ore, gold, copper)
fields.languages: Arabic (official and national), Pular, Soninke, Wolof (all national languages), French
fields.legal: mixed system of Islamic and French civil law
fields.military: 18 is the legal minimum age for voluntary military service; has a compulsory two-year military service law, but the law has reportedly never been applied
